### Day 63: 2 Samuel 14:1–33
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-63-2-samuel-14-133.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 14:14
Points:
- David's passivity following Amnon's crime allowed bitterness to take root in Absalom, prompting vigilante vengeance and exile.
- Joab recognized the unresolved grief and orchestrated the wise woman's plea to persuade David to bring Absalom home.
- David permitted Absalom to return to Jerusalem geographically but coldly denied him access to the royal presence.
- While David offered halfhearted pardon, God's nature is to welcome the banished back into full relationship.
- Failing to offer complete, heartfelt reconciliation hardened Absalom and closed the door to genuine restoration.
